terrainDescription.zh: 7,000多個島嶼組成，多山多火山，熱帶雨林與海岸線交錯，馬尼拉都會區高度密集
terrainDescription.en: An archipelago of 7,000+ islands, mountainous and volcanic, with rainforest and coastline interwoven; Metro Manila is intensely dense

plate.color: black text on white (private); black text on yellow (public utility vehicles — buses, taxis, jeepneys)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: Tall, square yellow road-marker stones ("mojones") are distinctively Filipino — not commonly seen elsewhere in East/Southeast Asia

utilityPole.transformerMount: Wooden "crucifix"-style crossbar is the most common pole type; a single insulator on a vertical bar attached to the pole's side is common outside the Zamboanga peninsula, where 3-insulator poletops dominate instead

historicalContext.zh: 菲律賓曾為西班牙殖民地，1945年由靠左行駛改為靠右行駛（美國治理時期影響），是東南亞少數靠右行駛的前歐洲殖民地。
historicalContext.en: A former Spanish colony, the Philippines switched from left- to right-hand traffic in 1945 under American administration — one of the few Southeast Asian ex-European colonies to drive on the right.
